hero.purpose: Primary above-the-fold visual — service introduction and trust

support.purpose: Mid-page supporting imagery — service detail, process, local relevance

trust.purpose: Trust and credibility — team, credentials, evidence, reassurance

conversion.purpose: Conversion band — booking, enquiry, contact encouragement

genericPromptTemplate: Create a {style} image for a {businessType} offering {serviceName} in {location}. The image should show {scene}, with {brandStyle}, suitable for the {slot} section of a local service page.
negativePromptTemplate: {baseNegative}. Avoid {slotSpecificAvoid}. No text overlays, logos, watermarks, or readable labels.

resolutionPipeline.name: Service context
resolutionPipeline.description: Load serviceKey, serviceName, businessName, location from campaign or intelligence

resolutionPipeline.name: Template family
resolutionPipeline.description: For pharmacy: map service to template family via template-architecture

resolutionPipeline.name: Slot resolution
resolutionPipeline.description: Map page slot (hero/support/trust/conversion) to imageKey via family slotResolution

resolutionPipeline.name: Asset lookup
resolutionPipeline.description: Check asset path in industry library manifest or pharmacy image library

resolutionPipeline.name: Prompt resolution
resolutionPipeline.description: Load AI prompt metadata from industry prompt pack when generation needed

resolutionPipeline.name: Unified output
resolutionPipeline.description: Return ResolvedUniversalImageIntelligence with alt, caption, assetPath, prompt

ideogramDefaults.styleGuidance: Match industry adapter — realistic photography for pharmacy, vector/UI mockup for digital services
imageSelectionCriteria: Matches recommended aspect ratio for slot
No readable text, logos or medication labels
Warm trustworthy lighting consistent with brand
Sharp focus on subjects, clean background

steps.name: Resolve service context
steps.description: serviceKey, templateFamily, location from intelligence layers

steps.name: Generate or load prompt
steps.description: AI prompt from industry prompt pack if asset missing

steps.name: Create images
steps.description: Manual Ideogram generation — not automated in this phase

steps.name: Upload to library
steps.description: Place at uploadTargetPath for industry adapter

steps.name: Render preview
steps.description: Industry renderer uses resolved asset or metadata placeholder

steps.name: Approve and deploy
steps.description: Clinical/brand review then live campaign wiring
